scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @dnd/server" "npm run dev -w @dnd/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/desktop
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run bundle -w @dnd/desktop && concurrently -n server,web,app -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @dnd/server" "npm run dev -w @dnd/web" "cross-env DND_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron apps/desktop"
